title: Piercing Frame Duo #015 (얼굴 컷 · [일반·P100 정의형·얼굴만·메이크업 GermanGlam] ; [일반·P8 집중형·얼굴만·메이크업 BollywoodGlam])
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. TWO women side by side, each facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, heads level, both ears of every woman clearly visible, framed tightly from the very top of their heads down to the base of their necks and the tops of their collarbones, the frame cutting off there. Every face is large and sharp. Mid 20s.

#1: A strikingly beautiful adult German woman — fair cool-toned skin, soft taupe eyeshadow, a glossy nude-pink lip, a distinct two-tone ombre with dark roots and a sharp transition to light ends hair styled in a mohawk with volume along the centre of the scalp. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#1 Piercings: An extreme, dense armour of about one hundred real yellow-gold piercings with a few yellow-gold coin drops among them covering the face: a thick yellow-gold septum ring with a smaller ring above it and two yellow-gold rings through each nostril; a straight yellow-gold bar across the bridge of the nose between the brows; five thick yellow-gold bars stacked through the outer half of each eyebrow; two rows of four small yellow-gold studs across the forehead above the brows; four small studs up each temple on the bone, well clear of the eyes; a row of six small studs along each cheekbone; a yellow-gold Medusa stud above the lips; a big yellow-gold hoop, two smaller rings and a snake-bite ring on each side through the lower lip's edge, and five small hoops along the upper lip's edge; a yellow-gold labret stud and four rings through the chin; five small studs along each jaw; on each ear a full dense row of ten oversized hoops, thick bars, stretched plugs, helix rings and studs from lobe to top, the biggest hoops hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulders; and eight fine yellow-gold chains looping from the ear hoops to the nostril rings and the septum ring. The piercings are packed so densely that the rows touch and overlap, leaving only hairline gaps of bare skin between them, until the face reads as a single armour of metal; the eyes and eyelids stay clear.

#2: A strikingly beautiful adult Indian woman — kohl-lined almond eyes, a small gold bindi, a deep maroon-red lip, warm golden-brown skin, warm auburn red-brown hair styled in a low chignon knot at the nape. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#2 Piercings: All eight piercings gather on the left side of her face and ear, and the right side stays bare: on the left ear five pieces — a huge bronze segment ring hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide bronze ear cuff, two smaller bronze rings and a small bronze stud at the top; two thin bronze bars pass through the outer end of the left eyebrow; a small bronze ring passes through the left nostril. Each piece carries small opals set into the metal.

All piercings: All jewelry is real metal, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Pose: each woman faces the camera, arms relaxed at her sides, heads level. Generous spacing so every face reads clearly.

Lighting: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. A soft frontal light on all the faces and ears, so the makeup and the glints on every piece of metal read clearly; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
